app.name: Sono-Renderer
language.title: Application language
language.description: Choose the language used by the Sono-Renderer interface. Your projects and creative content are unchanged.
language.review_notice: Translations are machine-drafted and have not received human linguistic review.
home.question: What would you like to do?
home.intro: Choose a goal. The same application supports Sonolus rendering, chart authoring, and standalone video editing.
home.render.title: Render a Level
home.render.body: Choose an engine, level, resources, and optional music, then make an MP4. Projects and advanced settings are optional.
home.chart.title: Create / Edit a Chart
home.chart.body: Open or create LevelData, edit entities, preview with the selected engine, validate, and export the level.
home.video.title: Edit a Video
home.video.body: Edit ordinary video, audio, images, and titles. Sonolus content is not required.
home.project.title: Open a Project
home.project.body: Continue a saved render-input project or a video composition.
home.learn.title: Learn
home.learn.body: Short, searchable guides for the workflows in this version.
quick.title: Quick Render
quick.description: Make a video from a Sonolus level. Projects and advanced settings are optional.
chart.title: Chart Studio
chart.description: Author chart data, preview it in the selected engine, validate, and export canonical LevelData.
chart.raw_notice: Field names are shown as data paths. Chart Studio does not guess gameplay meaning, timing, layout, or relationships.
presentation.title: Presentation Studio
presentation.description: Edit ordinary media without loading an engine, LevelData, Watch, or Sono-GCC.
